notes.title: The Sequel is Live!
notes.notes:
The live-action sequel to the Heroes Must Die game is live on Steam! See the world and characters of the game come to life, and experience the full story.

The game is still free, but if you enjoyed it consider buying or renting the show as a tip to the developers for our hard work. Thank you!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/569030/

notes.title: Heroes Must Die - the Show!
notes.notes:
Hello all. This is Rick Stemm, producer/creative lead for Heroes Must Die.

I'm pleased to announce the real-life version of Heroes Must Die will soon be available! 

As we mention in the game and store, the sequel to Heroes Must Die is a live action, audience-interactive stage show that follows the story of the game. We have obtained the video of the performance and are packaging for Steam now, hopefully in time for the holidays.

In the meantime, please enjoy this other piece of live-action video game absurdity I produced with our environment artist:

https://youtu.be/w5p8M4Jjyzg
